newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Metroplex says not in Reef Casino rescue.
newsitem.headline: Metroplex says not in Reef Casino rescue.

text.p: Malaysia's gaming and hotel company Metroplex Bhd said on Wednesday it was not involved in a deal to rescue Australia's ailing Reef Casino Trust.
A Metroplex spokeswoman said it had yet to formalise its stake in Sinophil Corp Inc, which was said to be participating in the bid for Reef Casino along with Australian Tourism Group (ATG).
"We are not sure who Sinophil is talking to. We are not involved," the spokewoman told Reuters by telephone.
Metroplex said there was no change in its plans to take a stake in Sinophil.

Metroplex has signed an agreement for a share swap between its Subic Bay Resorts (Hong Kong) Ltd and Sinophil. Under the deal Metroplex would swap 25 percent of its interest in the Subic Bay hotel unit for a 21.9 percent stake in Sinophil.
"As of today, the deal has not been completed. We are waiting for approval from the Securities Commission of the Philippines," the spokeswoman said.
In a statement issued earlier, Metroplex said: "We are not involved in the proposed (Reef Casino) rescue plan."

ATG, its associate Touraust Corp Pty Ltd and Sinophil had planned to form a joint venture to recapitalise, reorganise and start new marketing strategies for Reef Casino, owner of Cairns casino in Queensland state, an ATG spokesman said.
Under the proposal, Sinophil was to make a major investment in the joint venture and inject a significant amount of capital into Reef Casino Trust, he said.
